Mina — quick read: this is a sizeable ask but not impossible. Notes: 

- Rev-share splitting: AWS will only accept a single listing revenue share % on the private offer at time of submission. We can either set a lower marketplace fee or absorb part of the marketplace commission in our discount. Making AWS 15% instead of the market-standard 20% is an approval path (but it means Redwood net revenue drops ~5% across usage).
- 5yr term: Contract team flags data retention & indemnities that must survive long-term; legal will want a rolling audit clause and an escape for material regulatory changes.
- Net90: exposing Redwood cash flow; finance will want to model the NPV and may require a letter of credit or milestone-based invoice schedule instead of pure Net90.
- Upfront credit: treat as a contra-revenue or marketing credit; needs clear milestone triggers.

Recommendation: propose a structured compromise for execs: 3-year firm term with option to renew two additional years at pre-agreed rates (protects both parties), initial 30% discount (24 months) stepping to 20%, Redwood retains 82% of net after AWS fee (i.e., agree to 18% marketplace split), Net60 with an option for Net90 tied to milestone acceptance, and $150k upfront credit conditioned on three adoption milestones.

This preserves cash and reduces long-term exposure. If sales want to pursue 5yr/40%/85% split, we'll need explicit executive approval and a finance mitigation plan.

-Karthik

I ran the numbers and uploaded the model. Key takeaways: 

- 5yr / 40% / Net90 / $250k credit results in negative NPV under base-case churn assumptions unless we secure additional consumption guarantees.
- 3yr / 30% / Net60 / $150k credit yields positive NPV and acceptable payback within 18 months.
- If we move to an 18% marketplace fee (Redwood keeps 82%), incremental revenue delta vs standard is ~3.4% of Expected LifeTimeValue (ELTV).

Recommendation: Approve the 3yr structured deal with $150k credit + milestone acceptance; require Net60 with conditional Net90 tied to escrow/letter-of-credit or staged invoicing. Legal must build in milestone acceptance and escrow triggers.

I attached the model: longtail_pricing_model.csv and a summary PO template.

-Lauren
